project_context.name: Inventory Decision Support System (IDSS)
project_context.description: A modern, professional Decision Support System (DSS) for Purchasing, Warehouse, PPIC, and Directors. Focuses on inventory health monitoring and purchase planning recommendations. Designed for medium to large distribution companies.

visual_enhancers.borders_and_shadows: Use Linear-style quiet chrome. Thin 1px borders (border-slate-200) on all cards. Minimal soft shadows (shadow-sm) only for dropdowns and popovers. Flat cards for data.
visual_enhancers.ai_panel_styling: Give the AI Insight Panel a subtle Tracing Beam effect or a soft linear-gradient border to distinguish it as 'intelligent', paired with a light #eff6ff background.
visual_enhancers.traffic_lights: Implement traffic light indicators as small, glowing 8px circular dots (bg-red-500 shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(220,38,38,0.4)]) next to text, rather than large colored blocks.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Interactive rows in tables or lists should have a subtle background shift (hover:bg-slate-50) and buttons must have explicitly defined hover states (e.g., hover:bg-blue-700 hover:text-white).

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid. Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap: gap-4 or gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.kpi_cards: col-span-1. Compact padding (p-4 or p-5) to fit 10 KPIs neatly.
grids_and_layouts.charts: col-span-2 or col-span-4 depending on importance. Fixed heights (e.g., h-72).
grids_and_layouts.tables: Dense layout, horizontal scrolling enabled for wide datasets. Right-align numeric columns.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing between sections (py-8) but tight spacing within data clusters (gap-2).

component_guidelines.shadcn_usage: Extensively use Shadcn UI (Cards, Tables, Select, Dropdown, Tabs, Dialog, Badge). Customize them to remove Vercel-look by tightening padding and enforcing 1px borders.
component_guidelines.charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn Chart components). Ensure tooltips are responsive. Color palettes must match primary (blue), secondary (orange), and traffic light colors.
component_guidelines.navigation: Left sidebar layout. Sticky. Width 64 (256px). Use Lucide-React icons.
component_guidelines.tables: Include ABC Analysis column in Inventory Monitoring Table. Purchase Planning needs editable or actionable rows for recommendations.
component_guidelines.alerts_panel: A dedicated section or sidebar widget showing a prioritized list of alerts categorized by Red/Orange/Yellow/Green.

motion.strategy: Minimalist micro-interactions. No bouncy or slow animations.
motion.data_loading: Use skeleton loaders matching table/card shapes instead of spinning wheels.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against colored backgrounds (like primary buttons) is pure white. Traffic light text should be readable.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Example: data-testid='kpi-total-sku', data-testid='sidebar-nav-dashboard'.

3d_and_creative_libraries.usage: Use sparingly since this is an executive dashboard. Recharts is preferred for charts.
3d_and_creative_libraries.animations: framer-motion can be used for subtle tab switching or AI Insight Panel expansion.

instructions_to_main_agent.file_type: Create `.js` and `.jsx` files ONLY. Do NOT use TypeScript (`.ts`, `.tsx`).
instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Set up React Router with the requested main menu: Dashboard, Inventory Monitoring, Purchase Planning, Purchase Calendar, Data Upload, Master Data, Business Rules, Reports, Settings.
instructions_to_main_agent.dashboard_implementation: Build the main Dashboard view first. Include 10 KPI cards, Alert Panel, AI Insight Panel, and 4 Charts (Sales Trend, Inventory Trend, Incoming PO, by Category).
instructions_to_main_agent.data_mocking: Mock realistic data for ABC analysis, inventory levels, and purchase recommendations. Do not use generic 'Item 1', 'Item 2'. Use realistic distribution industry items (e.g., Electronics, FMCG, or Industrial parts).
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_setup: Implement the specific blue/orange color palette in tailwind.config.js.

GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Prioritize optical alignment over strict geometric alignment.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds for floating elements like dropdowns or sticky headers; use bg-white/90 with backdrop-blur-md.
Use progressive disclosure: don't overwhelm the user. Hide complex controls behind 'Advanced Filters' or context menus.
Data density is critical for executives. Eliminate unnecessary white space in tables, but keep margins generous outside components.
Group related information. Use subtle background colors (like a 50 weight) to delineate sections within cards if necessary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic by ensuring tight 1px borders, crisp colors, and excellent typographic hierarchy.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, NOT heavy box shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (transition-colors, transition-transform).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (sharp or slightly rounded with defined hover states).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use standard UI icons (Lucide/Phosphor).
Every interactive element needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings).
Include data-testid attributes on EVERYTHING interactive.
